			GAMIT SPRING DANCE 

When:		9pm-1am.  Friday, March 7. 

Where:		MIT Student Center "Lobdell",  84 Mass. Ave,Cambridge.

Who:		Everyone.  

Cost:		$2 with student ID, $3 everyone else.

Info:		(617)253-5440, or send mail to gamit@borax or gamit@nessus

Beer and Wine will be sold.
Persons under 21 will be admitted but not be allowed to purchase alcohol.
This year we are expecting between 300 to 400 people, mostly from
surrounding colleges.  People needing to stay overnight at MIT should
call to make arrangements.
